description: Ask for the playlist of a checklist that has none yet, for the person you serve, as CheckMyProgress's page asks: the same request, written by the same one writer. Give checklist_id and unitid (from find_checklists or get_checklist), and, if the person wants word when it is ready, their email (a lead) and lang. A request still open for the checklist is joined (the email added to it), else one is queued for the Playlist Builder, which builds it on its next run and emails the person once the playlist is published. The answer is this request's own standing only: request_id, status, step, and joined (true when an open request was joined). No build starts here and no course is kept; no other request or email is ever answered.

checklist_id.description: The checklist whose playlist is asked for

email.description: Optional: the person's email, to be sent word when the playlist is published

lang.description: Optional, with email: the language of that email (en, es or fr)

name: ask_for_my_playlist
title: Ask For My Playlist
